## My thinking this year

Me, I been doing this fifty years. Two mu of land, just me in the house now since my old woman passed and the kids went off to work in the city — they send money when they can. My eldest comes back for a few days at wheat harvest and maize planting, that's about it. The rest, I handle myself.

Two mu ain't much. My neighbors, some of them got ten, fifteen mu. But for an old man, two mu is plenty — too much some days, when my back is bad. I grow wheat and maize same as everybody in the village, same as I always done. Wheat in winter, maize in summer. That's how it goes here.

**For the wheat:** I'll plant around the cold dew festival (寒露), beginning of October when the weather turns. I buy the seed from the co-op — local variety, nothing fancy, about 15 kg per mu, I just scatter a bit heavier because with my hands now I can't be so careful with spacing. Before planting I put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — that's the blue bag, 50 jin to a bag, fifteen-fifteen-fifteen they call it, though I don't pay much attention to the numbers. One bag per mu, same as always. Then when the wheat greens up in spring around the awakening of insects (惊蛰), I topdress with urea — maybe half a bag across the two mu, sprinkled by hand before a rain or before I turn on the water.

Water — I go to the well three times usually. Once before winter so the ground don't freeze dry, once at greening, once when it's heading out. Water costs money now, the electric meter runs when you pump. If the rain comes I skip one. This year I'll wait and see.

For weeds I spray once in spring, the herbicide the little shop sells — I tell the shopkeeper wheat and he gives me the right one. I don't spray bugs unless I see them bad. Harvest I pay the combine man, 50 yuan per mu, he comes through the village in June. Last year I got about four bags per mu threshed out — 400 jin or so. Not bad for an old man.

**For the maize:** Right after wheat harvest, no time to rest. The planter man comes through with a machine that plants right into the stubble, I pay him 40 yuan per mu, saves me the tillage. Hybrid seed — everybody uses hybrid now, I buy one small bag at the co-op, whatever variety my neighbor 老王 bought because his looked good last year. About 60 yuan for the seed for two mu.

Fertilizer for maize — I put down a bit of compound when he plants, and then when the maize gets to about waist-high, at big flare stage (大喇叭口期), I stick urea in between the rows, that's the main feed. Maybe 30 jin of urea across the two mu. I don't irrigate maize unless it's really dry — usually the summer rain handles it. Last summer was dry and I watered once. Herbicide sprayed once when the maize is small. Yield last year was about 900 jin total off the two mu, 450 per mu — decent year.

I got maybe 2000 yuan set aside for inputs this year. Should be enough. If it gets tight I skip the last irrigation on wheat or use a little less urea on maize. Can't spend what I don't got.
